description: This file implements the Onboarding Wizard model and related UI components for onboarding steps within a macOS app. It manages the onboarding session state, communicates with backend services, and provides SwiftUI views for user interaction during onboarding.

classes.name: OnboardingWizardModel
classes.description: A final class conforming to Observable that manages the onboarding wizard's session state, handles starting, submitting steps, cancelling, and session recovery.

methods.name: startIfNeeded
methods.description: Initiates the onboarding process if required, performing gateway checks and starting the wizard session.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Submits the user's response for a particular wizard step and processes the result.

methods.name: cancelIfRunning
methods.description: Cancels an ongoing wizard session if it is currently running.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the wizard's internal state variables.
